en:
Yay! I'm with Shuichi again!
Happy, happy me! Nyahahaha!
Y-Yeah, happy...

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie's been pretty happy
lately, I wonder why.

Hey, hey Shuichi. Guess what?
I got a present for you today.

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie pulled out what looked like
a small board covered in fabric.

Here, Shuichi. Unwrap the cloth, okay?
Slowly, gently...

<CLT=cltMIND>I unwrapped the cloth carefully,
just as she said...

<CLT=cltMIND>and saw a canvas about the size
of my palm. And on that canvas...

You made this, right, Angie?
What's it of?

Huh? You don't recognize it?
It's your face, silly.
This is me!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Not only does it not look like me,
it doesn't even look human...
Yep, yep! I want you to have it.
Ah, th-thank you...

Hmm, hmm... You don't faint when you see
my pictures anymore.

Yay! I'm so happy I've gotten closer with
you.

Now that you mention it, that is true...
Perhaps I've just gotten used to it.

No, Shuichi.
You were chosen by Atua.

And now, you're ready to be Angie's
husband. Isn't it wonderful?

H-Husband!?
Where is this coming from!?

Atua has spoken... Shuichi can be with
Angie forever.

Hey, Angie...
Does Atua decide everything for you?
Even your own husband?
Hm? Well...
Maybe I want you to be my husband...
What...?
Cuz I really do wanna be with you forever.
Are you confessing your love?
This is getting kind of heavy...
I can't do it!
Are you unsure of something?
Does this mean I chose you, not Atua?
Are you confessing your love?
Confession?

Ah, yeah, because you
clearly like me and all...

Ohhhh, I see, I see! Is that all? You just
wanna know if I like you, too?
Okay, I do! There, it's decided!

But choosing a husband is an important
decision, you need to think about it more!
Th-This is getting kind of heavy...

Huh? But everyone who's ever carried me
says I'm really light.

No, I don't mean your weight...
I mean, this is a life-changing decision.

Nyahahaha! It'll be fine!
We've got Atua on our side.

<CLT=cltMIND>That doesn't make me
feel any better!

But you can't pick a groom
so casually like that.

You're going to be with them for
the rest of your life...

W-Wait, what am I saying!? We shouldn't
even be talking about this at our age!

Huh? Huhhh? Are you defying the word
of Atua? If you do that...
You will be cursed for generations to come.

O-Okay, but...this is still not
a decision to be taken lightly...

And why did you pick me?
I'm just an ordinary guy compared to you.

But you're not ordinary.
My first time was with you.

...Wait.
Wh-What do you mean, "first time"!?

You're the first one to ever get angry
at me.

Since that moment...I haven't been able
to stop thinking about you...
I just think about you all the time.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I see...
I suppose Angie never got scolded before.

<CLT=cltMIND>After all, on her home island,
her words were the words of Atua.

<CLT=cltMIND>Of course, if Angie admits that
she got mad at me...

<CLT=cltMIND>That must mean that those are her
genuine feelings, not Atua.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's good... It's a little strange, but
there is definitely a bond between us now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, of course, there's
still the matter of...

Hey, Shuichi? Will you be my husband and
stay with me forever?

<CLT=cltMIND>We aren't *that* close yet!
I can't be her husband!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Angie's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've learned a new skill,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Atua's Intuition<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>I somehow dodged Angie's proposal,
and I returned to my room.
